description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Mr. Murugesu Ganeshamoorthy as Secretary to the Ministry of National Intergration & Reconciliation from 09.11.2015. Notifying that Hon. Thilak Janaka Marapana has resigned the Office of Minister of Law & Order & Prison Reforms from 09.11.2015. Appointed Hon. D.M. Swaminathan as Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement & Hindu Religious Affairs & Hon. Sagala Gajendra Ratnayaka as Minister of Law & Order & Southern Development from 11.11.2015
categorisation: The gazette contains both government personnel changes (appointments and resignations of named individuals including Mr. Murugesu Ganeshamoorthy, Hon. D. M. Swaminathan, Hon. Sagala Gajendra Ratnayaka, and Hon. Thilak Janaka Marapana) AND detailed portfolio responsibilities (e.g., "Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement & Hindu Religious Affairs", "Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development"). This combination of specific people names with detailed ministerial portfolio descriptions meets the criteria for Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
